recycling.tagline: Closing the Loop on Additive Polymers
recycling.heroTitle: Sustainable 3D Printing: Recycle Your Failed Prints & Spools
recycling.heroSubtitle: We are pioneering a closed-loop recycling program. Send us your failed PLA/PETG prints, supports, and empty spools to earn store credits and receive 100% recycled high-grade filament.
recycling.step1Desc: Store your scrap PLA, PETG, and ABS separately in our prepaid return containers.
recycling.step2Desc: Our processing facilities shred, decontaminate, and re-extrude polymers with laser precision tolerance (+/- 0.02mm).
recycling.step3Desc: Receive closed-loop certified recycled filament rolls and automatic discount vouchers for your printer farm.
